title: Access Log Bot Detection Summary
description: Bot classification for aggregated access-log summary records, expressed as additive counts of requests in three mutually exclusive bands (bot, uncertain, not-bot). The bands are derived upstream from per-request bot scores using customer-chosen thresholds; setting the bot and uncertain thresholds equal collapses to a two-way bot / not-bot split. Counts are additive and re-aggregate correctly at any grain. The optional bot name mirrors the standard ExperienceEvent Bot Detection field group and is populated only when bot name is used as a grouping dimension. These fields are system-generated and not user-editable.

xdm:botDetection.title: Bot Detection
xdm:botDetection.description: Bot classification counts for the aggregated requests.

xdm:botRequests.title: Bot Request Count
xdm:botRequests.description: Number of aggregated requests classified as bots (per-request bot score at or above the customer's bot threshold).

xdm:uncertainRequests.title: Uncertain Request Count
xdm:uncertainRequests.description: Number of aggregated requests whose bot classification is uncertain (per-request bot score between the customer's not-bot and bot thresholds). Zero when the two thresholds are equal.

xdm:notBotRequests.title: Not-Bot Request Count
xdm:notBotRequests.description: Number of aggregated requests classified as not bots (per-request bot score at or below the customer's not-bot threshold).

xdm:name.title: Name
xdm:name.description: Bot name from the matched detection rule (for example the IAB or customer rule name). Populated only when the summary is grouped by bot name.
